management_notes: Upside Gold Corp. commenced trading on the CSE on January 5, 2026 — this is a freshly listed company with a limited public execution track record. Management has been active at industry conferences (PDAC 2026, CSE Investor Luncheon, Miami 'Going Public' event), which is appropriate investor-relations activity for a new listing. The May 2026 finalisation of additional claims adjacent to Kena demonstrates deal-making capability. Score is held at 2 pending evidence of a funded drill program and an updated NI 43-101 resource.
geology_notes: The Kena Gold-Copper Project covers over 10,000 hectares in the Kootenay Volcanic Arc of southeastern British Columbia — a belt with documented gold and silver mineralisation since the early 1900s. A historical (non-NI 43-101-compliant) resource estimate filed in 2021 reports approximately 561,900 oz Au in the indicated category and 2.77 Moz Au in the inferred category, totalling roughly 3.33 Moz Au. The project also hosts copper mineralisation along a previously identified 3 km copper-gold trend. Score reflects genuine exploration scale but is capped at 3 until the historical estimate is updated to a compliant NI 43-101 standard.
capital_notes: No cap-table data was available from extracted filings. As a January 2026 IPO on the CSE, the share structure likely includes IPO warrants and agent options from the initial listing and any concurrent private placement. Canadian small-cap CSE listings of this type commonly use flow-through share financing to fund exploration programs in BC; investors should review the most recent press releases and financial statements to identify any outstanding flow-through tranches and their hold-release dates before committing.
catalyst_notes: The 2026 work program is described as exploration along the 3 km copper-gold trend and follow-up on the historical resource. The May 2026 claims acquisition (approx. 273 ha adjacent to Kena) expands the land package. No drill program start date has been announced in available sources as of this research date. The next material catalyst is the announcement and commencement of a drill program — until that happens, newsflow is largely administrative.
acquisition_notes: A historical resource base of approximately 3.33 Moz Au in BC's Kootenay region carries real optionality at current junior gold valuations. If the company can convert the historical estimate to a current NI 43-101 compliant resource, the project would command a meaningful market capitalisation uplift. BC jurisdiction is well-regarded by acquirers. However, until the resource is validated by modern drilling, P/NAV analysis is not reliable.
analyst_summary: Upside Gold is a newly listed CSE junior with a large but unvalidated historical gold resource in a proven BC mining belt. The Kena Project has genuine scale — 3.33 Moz Au historical estimate plus copper — but the resource predates modern NI 43-101 standards and has not been tested by the current team. The company is doing the right things for a new listing: attending conferences, acquiring additional claims, and laying the groundwork for a drill program. None of that earns a BUY yet. WATCH until a funded, systematic drill program is announced and the first assays validate the historical grades. Cap-table data was not available; investors should verify the share structure and any flow-through overhang before entering.
